claims: LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is located in East Elmhurst, a neighborhood in the borough of Queens in New York City.
LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is situated roughly 8 miles from Midtown Manhattan.
LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is bordered by the Grand Central Parkway and Flushing Bay.
LaGuardia Airport (LGA) address is 94-00 Grand Central Pkwy, East Elmhurst, NY 11369.
LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is ~8 miles from Manhattan.
LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is roughly 30–40 minutes by car from Manhattan depending on traffic.
LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is ~11–13 miles from JFK Airport.
Coordinates of LaGuardia Airport (LGA) are approximately 40°46′38.1″N 73°52′21.4″W.
LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is divided into Terminals A, B, and C.
LaGuardia Airport (LGA) primarily handles domestic flights within the United States.
LaGuardia Airport (LGA) handles some short international flights to Canada and the Caribbean
